build.summary:
I built proc-chart-planted-problems. Each full-case patient now gets a pre-procedure record with exactly one planted problem from the manuals' checklists. The record covers medications with last-dose times, bloods and their age, devices, arms and groins, resuscitation status, pre-assessment notes and, where it applies, the pregnancy test.

- **Pure core (src/simulation/session/planning.ts):**
  - The 11 problem definitions: chart item, correct actions, lesson, tips and module-text source.
  - Brilakis Table 1.2, with Oxford's 24 h (72 h for dabigatran in renal impairment) accepted as an alternative.
  - Seeded record generation with problem detection that runs independently of it.
  - The action menu, and Oxford's eight-item pre-puncture checklist.
- **Session module 'planning':**
  - Reading a record item takes chart time. Every action writes the ledger. The first fitting action before the time-out scores the problem found; a time-out without one scores it missed, with the debrief linking pm-planning-assessment.
  - Hold and delay ends the case: the needle is refused from then on.
  - Premedication gives Oxford's hydrocortisone 100 mg and chlorphenamine 10 mg IV, then waits the hour. Check INR, repeat bloods, the pregnancy test and clarifying resuscitation status each take time and return a result.
  - Case events (pde5-recent, contrast-sensitive, pregnancy-possible) are raised only once the item that states them has been read.
- **Consequences come from the patient:**
  - A DOAC inside its hold, or warfarin at an unchecked INR, raises the baseline ACT (model parameter).
  - The PDE-5 inhibitor makes the engine's nitroglycerin response larger through the existing interaction table.
  - Nitroglycerin given inside the PDE-5 window is scored.
  - A puncture in the plug groin or the fistula arm is scored, and a closure device is refused in the plug groin.
  - Handing to PCI despite planned surgery, and fluoroscopy before a pregnancy test, are scored.
- **Checklist:**
  - SpO2 is read from the monitor and refused at 96% or below, with an oxygen button.
  - Confirming the manifold or transducer item without the line flushed or the transducer zeroed is recorded as a false confirmation, as the time-out does.
  - In supervised and exam modes placeNeedle is blocked until the checklist is complete. The first skin puncture scores it in every mode.
- **Scenarios:** 12 in scenarios/planning.ts, one per problem plus 'checklist' opened ready to puncture, with their .launch.ts. The chart section PlantedProblems.tsx shows the record, the actions and the checklist, and never says which item is the problem or whether an action was right.
- **patient.ts** gains pure helpers only: childbearingPotential, residualAnticoagActRiseS and MP_PRE_PROCEDURE. generatePatient is unchanged.

Typecheck is clean and all new tests pass. One existing test owned by another package now fails, because the autopilot does not yet act on the planted problem or the checklist (see outOfScope).

acceptance.criterion: planning.test.ts: every generated patient in a fixed seed set has exactly one planted problem and the chart states it
acceptance.evidence: The test covers 300 seeds across three access routes. For each, problemsPresent(facts, access) equals [planted], the planted problem's chart item contains statedBy(...), and the record is deterministic per seed. A further 10 live newCaseSession cases pass (the record reads the session chart's DOAC dose time), as does each of the 11 planning scenarios.

acceptance.criterion: 'pde5-24h' with GTN drops true MAP more than the same dose without the flag
acceptance.evidence: gtnDrop() opens pde5-24h at sheath-in, gives GTN 200 µg intra-arterially and takes the lowest aortaTrue.mean over the next minute. A control without profile.pde5 gives a smaller drop: in exploration 6 against 1 mmHg on this seed (12 against 5 on the original seed). The effect comes from the formulary's existing interaction gain.

acceptance.criterion: 'doac-recent' with 'hold and delay' records a correct decision and ends the case; missed, the debrief links pm-planning-assessment
acceptance.evidence: After hold and delay, planning-problem and planning-action-hold-and-delay are both recorded correct, state.postponed is set, placeNeedle returns false with a stop line, and further actions return null. Missed: prepare() completes the time-out, planning-problem is recorded false with lessonId pm-planning-assessment, and the ACT baseline rises. Caveat: the case 'ends' inside the module only; the store's finish() still needs closure (see outOfScope).

acceptance.criterion: placeNeedle in supervised mode is blocked while SpO2 is unconfirmed
acceptance.evidence: In the checklist scenario in supervised mode, with the time-out done and every item confirmed except SpO2, placeNeedle returns false and the attending stop line names the SpO2 item. Once SpO2 is confirmed (or oxygen given first), placeNeedle returns true. The block applies where the policy requires a time-out (supervised and exam), as the time-out gate does.

acceptance.criterion: browser: __caseSession.scenario('closure-device-90d') shows the device on ultrasound of that groin
acceptance.evidence: The plug is in the record, its groin is known once punctured (state.plugSite), and a closure device is refused there. Drawing a plug on ultrasound needs src/simulation/access/site.ts and src/ui/access/UltrasoundView.tsx, which are not this package's files (see outOfScope). Not checked in a browser.

acceptance.criterion: practiceIndex lists the scenarios doac-recent, warfarin-inr-unchecked, metformin-ckd under lessons pm-planning-assessment, pm-planning-preparation, pm-to-the-root-table (from src/simulation/session/scenarios/planning.launch.ts)
acceptance.evidence: All three scenarios are listed under pm-planning-assessment and pm-planning-preparation. Under pm-to-the-root-table (the table set-up lesson) the 'checklist' scenario is listed instead, because that lesson teaches the pre-puncture checklist rather than chart review. If the literal reading (all three under all three lessons) is wanted, it is a two-line change in planning.launch.ts and scenarios/planning.ts. PRACTICE_INDEX reports no problems for planning.launch.

acceptance.criterion: Tips: after the action that raises 'hypotension', tipsFor(ctx, 20) includes diag-planning-pde5-nitrate, and at phase 'setup' it includes diag-planning-contrast-allergy; every waiting.ts entry naming proc-chart-planted-problems becomes satisfiable
acceptance.evidence: Tested in pde5-24h, not doac-recent, because nothing in doac-recent produces hypotension and the tip is about the PDE-5 and nitrate combination. Two GTN doses raise 'hypotension' (MAP below 65 for 10 s) only with the sildenafil; diag-planning-pde5-nitrate then appears in tipsFor of the diagnostic setup context, at the table and at the chart. diag-planning-contrast-allergy appears in tipsFor(setup ctx, 20) in contrast-allergy-unpremedicated. No WAITING_TIPS or DEFERRED_RETARGETS entry names this package (asserted to be zero), so the 'falls by at least their number' clause is vacuous. The module exports raises (pde5-recent, contrast-sensitive, pregnancy-possible) for the access, diagnostic and PCI labs.

outOfScope: src/simulation/session/autopilot.ts: prepare() must play the new planning step cleanly. It should read each record item (planningOf(s).actions.readItem), act on the planted problem with its first correct action other than hold-and-delay (PLANTED_PROBLEMS[planted].correct), then run s.flushLine() and s.zero() and confirm every PRE_PUNCTURE_CHECKLIST item (oxygen first if SpO2 is refused). Without this, scenarios.test.ts 'with the scored steps of a clean case' (seed led-1, which draws surgery-planned) fails, and in supervised or exam mode a chart-start autopilot run would be stopped at the needle. Note: a random DOAC patient whose last dose is inside both manuals' holds can only be held and delayed, so the 'every decision correct' assertion should use a seed without one.

src/simulation/session/modules/index.ts and caseSession.ts: there is no module hook to gate an action. The planning module wraps the session instance's placeNeedle and femoralDevice in attach() and restores them on dispose. A CaseSessionModule.gate?(action) consulted by placeNeedle and femoralDevice would be cleaner. A public say() or attending API for modules would also help: the module currently pushes stop lines into session.attending and session.log directly.

src/simulation/session/caseSession.ts finish() and src/state/useProcedureStore.ts finish(): a case postponed by hold and delay before any puncture cannot be finished, because closureDone() needs a closed site. A postponed-case end path, for example finish() accepting the planning module's postponed state, is needed so the debrief and logbook row appear.

src/simulation/access/site.ts and src/ui/access/UltrasoundView.tsx: draw an anchor-and-collagen-plug in the femoral artery of the groin named by the record (planningOf(s).state.record.facts.closureDevice), for the browser acceptance item.

src/simulation/patient/engine.ts and responses.ts (owned by found-patient-formulary): the design asks premedication to scale the previous-reaction probability. The engine draws the reaction from profile.allergies.contrast alone. This package relies on the existing anti-allergic effect of hydrocortisone and chlorphenamine, which reduces a reaction's severity but not its likelihood. A probability-scaling input (or an armContrastReaction API) would make a missed allergy show more reliably.

docs/realism/facts (a new section or file): record the model parameters added here, which are labelled in code only: MP_PRE_PROCEDURE in patient.ts (childbearing age limit and the ACT rises for a residual DOAC or warfarin), MP_PLANNING in planning.ts (the renal-impairment and CKD limits, the do-not-resuscitate age, the fallback hold below 15 mL/min and the drawn ranges) and MP_PLANNING_TIME and MP_OXYGEN_LPM in modules/planning.ts.
build.notes:
Snapshot: datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/proc-chart-planted-problems/ holds src/simulation/patient/patient.ts, the only listed file that existed before; the .started marker is there. patient.ts was last modified on 8 October, so the snapshot is the pre-package state.

Design choices to review:
1. Problem priority: a problem the patient carries comes first (PDE-5 inhibitor, then a DOAC inside Brilakis's hold, then a previous contrast reaction), then a scenario's forced problem, then a seeded draw. Random draws exclude the closure-device and fistula problems, which come only from their scenarios, so the planted problem never invalidates the route a random case was planned with.
2. To keep exactly one problem, facts that are not the planted problem are written as handled: diabetic patients' metformin is held, warfarin patients have today's INR, and a second contrast reaction is shown as premedicated. For that last case the engine is given Oxford's IV regimen at attach as a stand-in for the oral course.
3. A case opened past the chart was planned by the team, so no planning decisions are scored. Past 'access' the checklist is also taken as done, so autopilot starts work in supervised mode.
4. The ACT rise mutates session.profile.act, the profile object the engine reads. It is applied only when the planted problem is doac-recent or warfarin-inr-unchecked.
5. The pde5-24h scenario uses seed planning-pde5-149 (resting pressure 96/58) so that repeated sourced GTN doses cross the 65 mmHg hypotension threshold with sildenafil and not without it.

Every dose, window and threshold is cited from the module text in comments (01-planning.ts, 06-to-the-root.ts, PDE5_WINDOW_H) or labelled MODEL PARAMETER. The UI uses generic names and Clinical Graphite classes, and shows no ground truth.

Not verified in the browser.

findings.where: src/simulation/session/planning.ts: planFacts / chartOnlyEligible / recordItems / PLANTED_PROBLEMS (doac-recent, bloods-old, surgery-planned)
findings.problem: Every random full case gets the elective out-patient record, whatever the indication. I ran a probe over 1,000 seeds with generatePatient and buildPlanningRecord: 521 were STEMI, 56 NSTEMI and 122 UA. Among the STEMI cases, 227 were planted bloods-old ('taken N days ago, at the out-patient pre-assessment'), 194 surgery-planned (the only correct action is 'Diagnostic study only'), 36 doac-recent (the only correct action is 'Hold and delay the case', or proceed only after Oxford's 24 h) and 43 dnacpr-unsuspended. The record also says 'Consent discussed at pre-assessment; out-patient day case' next to 'P2Y12 inhibitor: loading dose given on admission.' The rules do not apply here. Brilakis Table 1.2 is captioned 'before an elective catheter procedure'. The 14-day bloods rule is for out-patients (01-planning.ts line 425: 24 hours for an in-patient). For a STEMI, the module text says anticoagulation favours radial access, not postponement (line 88). As built, the lab scores 'delay primary PCI' and 'diagnostic only' as correct for STEMI patients.
findings.fix: Add `setting: 'elective' | 'acute'` to PlanningFacts, set from `profile.indication === 'SA'`. In planFacts, for acute cases: (a) do not add doac-recent to `carried`, and gate it in problemsPresent on setting === 'elective'. (b) Restrict chartOnlyEligible to ['dnacpr-unsuspended', 'pregnancy-test']. (c) Draw bloods as 'taken on admission today' and never plant bloods-old or surgery-planned. (d) Do not hold metformin 'as instructed at pre-assessment'. In recordItems, write in-patient wording for acute cases ('Admitted with ...; bloods on admission'), not 'out-patient day case'. For an acute contrast reaction, use Brilakis's emergency IV hydrocortisone 100 mg as soon as possible (01-planning.ts line 611), not the hour's wait. An acute patient may be eligible for no problem (for example a man under 65 with no allergy). In that case, plant nothing and score no planning-problem decision. Amend the acceptance wording to 'every elective patient', and add a test that an acute (STEMI) seed never gets doac-recent, bloods-old or surgery-planned, and never scores hold-and-delay as correct.

findings.where: src/simulation/session/scenarios.test.ts 'session.decide() records appear in finish().decisions, with the scored steps of a clean case' (via src/simulation/session/autopilot.ts prepare())
findings.problem: An existing test owned by another package now fails, and I reproduced the failure. The autopilot does not act on the planted problem or on the checklist, so seed led-1 (surgery-planned) gets planning-problem and pre-puncture-checklist scored false. In supervised or exam mode, a chart-start autopilot run is now also stopped at the needle ('the needle could not be placed').
findings.fix: Do not merge until a follow-up change to autopilot.ts lands; it is out of this package's scope. In prepare(): (1) read every item with planningOf(s)?.actions.readItem. (2) Act with the first entry of PLANTED_PROBLEMS[planted].correct that is not 'hold-and-delay'. Where hold-and-delay is the only option (doac-recent inside both holds), choose 'proceed' when Oxford's hold is met. (3) Run s.flushLine() and s.zero(), then confirm each PRE_PUNCTURE_CHECKLIST item, calling giveOxygen() first if spo2 is refused. Also switch the scenarios.test.ts seed to one without a DOAC inside its hold.

findings.problem: Hold and delay leaves the case with no way to finish. CaseSession.finish() and useProcedureStore.finish() both need closureDone(), and a postponed case has no closed site. There is no debrief and no logbook row, yet the notice tells the learner 'The decisions are in the debrief.' The acceptance criterion 'ends the case' is only met inside the module.
findings.fix: Now, within this package: change the notice to something true, for example 'Case postponed and rebooked. Start a new patient to continue.' Follow-up (caseSession.ts and useProcedureStore.ts): let finish() accept a postponed case, for example `if (!this.closureDone() && !(planning postponed with no site punctured)) return null`, so the debrief and logbook row appear.

findings.where: src/simulation/session/scenarios/planning.ts and planning.launch.ts (lessonIds of doac-recent, warfarin-inr-unchecked, metformin-ckd)
findings.problem: Acceptance is not met as written. The plan asks for doac-recent, warfarin-inr-unchecked and metformin-ckd to be listed under pm-planning-assessment, pm-planning-preparation and pm-to-the-root-table. They are listed under the first two only. Only 'checklist' is under pm-to-the-root-table, and the test was rewritten to assert the deviation.
findings.fix: Either add TABLE to the lessonIds of those three scenarios in both scenarios/planning.ts and planning.launch.ts, and change the planning.test.ts practice-index test to loop over all three lessons, or get the plan entry amended before acceptance. Do not keep a test that asserts something other than the criterion.

findings.where: src/simulation/session/scenarios/planning.ts (closure-device-90d, dialysis-fistula, doac-recent, bloods-old, and every scenario built on CLEAN)
findings.problem: The session chart's 'Previous access' item contradicts the record or adds a second concern, which I confirmed by probing the scenarios. In closure-device-90d, history reads 'Previous coronary bypass grafting with a left internal mammary artery graft' while the record says 'Right femoral angiogram 24 days ago, closed with an anchor-and-collagen-plug closure device'. In dialysis-fistula, history reads 'Previous coronary angiography through the right radial artery; a weak right radial pulse is documented since' for a patient with a right forearm fistula and a planned right radial case. doac-recent and bloods-old also show the weak right radial pulse with a planned right radial route. That breaks 'that problem and no other'.
findings.fix: Give each planning scenario a chart history override. For CLEAN scenarios, add `chart: { history: 'No previous arterial access.' }`. closure-device-90d: `chart: { history: 'Previous right femoral coronary angiography, closed with a closure device (details in the pre-procedure record).' }`. dialysis-fistula: `chart: { history: 'No previous arterial access; right forearm arteriovenous fistula for haemodialysis.' }`. Add a test that, in each planning scenario, s.chart.history.text holds no previous-radial or weak-pulse finding on the planned route.

findings.where: Acceptance 'browser: __caseSession.scenario('closure-device-90d') shows the device on ultrasound of that groin'
findings.problem: Not met. Nothing draws the anchor-and-collagen plug on ultrasound, and SiteOverrides has no field for one. The design's 'plug visible on ultrasound' consequence is therefore missing.
findings.fix: Follow-up package, outside this one's files. Add a plug option to SiteOverrides or the femoral site build in src/simulation/access/site.ts, set from planningOf(s).state.record.facts.closureDevice. Draw it in src/ui/access/UltrasoundView.tsx as a small echogenic intraluminal or anterior-wall anchor with an extravascular collagen plug. Then check it in the browser.

findings.problem: The residual-anticoagulant ACT rise is applied only when doac-recent or warfarin-inr-unchecked is the planted problem. A random warfarin patient (chart 'INR today' 1.8 to 3.2) never gets the rise, but the warfarin-inr-unchecked scenario patient does. The header says 'the anticoagulant is in the patient whether or not the learner reads the chart', and the code contradicts that.
findings.fix: Compute the rise from the facts, not the planted id: warfarin from facts.warfarin.inrToday, and a DOAC when hoursSinceDose is inside its hold. Then run the access, closure and ACT tests of other packages, since random warfarin patients will change ACT. Alternatively, document that the rise is a teaching consequence of the planted problem only, and correct the header comment.

findings.where: src/simulation/session/planning.ts planFacts (doac agent default 'apixaban') and recordItems
findings.problem: For a random DOAC patient (no profile.doac), the session chart says 'Direct oral anticoagulant; last dose X h ago' while the record says 'Apixaban: last dose X h ago'. The two disagree, and the agent comes from a default, not from the patient.
findings.fix: When profile.doac is undefined, make the record line read 'Direct oral anticoagulant (apixaban): last dose X h ago', or draw the agent in the planning RNG and say in the line that it is from the pre-assessment medicines list. Keep the Brilakis hold computed for the agent shown.

findings.problem: Several consequence paths have no test: the planning-nitrate decision (gtnDrop never checks it), planning-fistula-arm, planning-stent-candidacy at handover to PCI, planning-pregnancy-before-radiation, check-inr in warfarin-inr-unchecked and its ACT rise, and clarify-resuscitation. The SpO2 test puts giveOxygen behind `if (!confirmCheck('spo2'))`. The checklist seed reads 97%, so that branch never runs and giveOxygen is untested.
findings.fix: Add one test per path. Examples: pde5-24h plus gtn, expecting decisions to include planning-nitrate with correct false; dialysis-fistula fastForward to sheath-in, expecting planning-fistula-arm false; surgery-planned handover('pci'), expecting planning-stent-candidacy false; pregnancy-test fluoroscopy, expecting planning-pregnancy-before-radiation false; warfarin-inr-unchecked act('check-inr'), expecting inrAgeH 0 and actRiseS > 0. For oxygen: mock vitals to spo2 95 with respiratory.oxygenLpm 0, assert confirmCheck fails and the note says 'Give oxygen first', assert giveOxygen() is true and the engine's vitals().respiratory.oxygenLpm is 2, then mock 97 and assert confirmCheck passes.

findings.where: Acceptance 'Tips ... in scenario doac-recent, after the action that raises hypotension'
findings.problem: The tips test was run in pde5-24h, not doac-recent. The change is defensible, because nothing in doac-recent raises hypotension through a nitrate and the tip is about PDE-5. Even so, it departs from the plan's wording.
findings.fix: Get the plan entry amended to name pde5-24h. If the literal criterion is wanted, add a doac-recent case in which hypotension comes from bleeding at the puncture site, and assert which tips appear then.

findings.problem: The section headings use 'text-[12px] uppercase tracking-wide'. That breaks Clinical Graphite, which uses sentence case and no all-caps tracked labels. The 'Do it' button label is also informal.
findings.fix:
Replace with sentence-case headings, for example `
Pre-procedure record
`, or use the panel-head pattern used by other chart sections. Rename the button to 'Record action'.

findings.problem: stop() pushes into session.attending and session.log directly, bypassing say(). Each blocked needle click adds another identical stop line, and in exam mode each one is marked critical. state.consequences is collected but nothing reads it: no debrief or panel uses it.
findings.fix: Skip the push when the last attending line has the same text and is less than 5 s old. Either surface state.consequences in the debrief (a follow-up in the debrief owner's files) or remove the field, since the decisions already carry the information.

findings.where: docs/realism/facts (no entry for MP_PRE_PROCEDURE, MP_PLANNING, MP_PLANNING_TIME, MP_OXYGEN_LPM)
findings.problem: The model parameters are labelled in code but not recorded in docs/realism/facts, which the project rules require. Separately, the design's 'premedication scales the previous-reaction probability' is not implemented: a missed allergy keeps the same reaction probability and differs only in severity. Both need files outside this package, as the builder reported.
findings.fix: Follow-up: add a docs/realism/facts section that lists each parameter, its value and its 'model, not population' rationale. In found-patient-formulary's engine or responses.ts, add a premedication factor on the previous-reaction probability, labelled MODEL PARAMETER, that this module can set when premedication is given.

review.verdict: Not ready to accept. Typecheck (npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit) is clean, and the package's 21 tests pass (planning.test.ts and modules/planning.tips.test.ts). The store, caseTips, practiceIndex and launch-store tests also pass (47). scenarios.test.ts has one existing test failing, because the autopilot does not yet play the new planning step; caseSession.test.ts passes. patient.ts differs from its snapshot only by the new pure helpers; generatePatient is unchanged. The other files under src/ modified since .started are all PCI-lab and X-ray files from other packages and do not touch planning. The sourced numbers check out against the module text (Brilakis Table 1.2, the 14 days, 24 h INR, 90 days, 6-12 months, 96%, the Oxford premedication and the PDE-5 windows). Live screens show no ground truth. The critical problem is that the out-patient record and its elective rules apply to every random case. About half of those are STEMI, and the lab scores 'hold and delay' or 'diagnostic only' as correct for them. Also outstanding: the failing scenarios.test.ts, a postponed case that cannot reach its debrief, two acceptance criteria unmet (the pm-to-the-root-table listing and the plug on ultrasound), and scenario charts whose 'Previous access' contradicts the record. Paths: /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/session/planning.ts, .../src/simulation/session/modules/planning.ts, .../src/simulation/session/scenarios/planning.ts, .../src/simulation/session/scenarios/planning.launch.ts, .../src/ui/access/chart/PlantedProblems.tsx, .../src/simulation/session/planning.test.ts, .../src/simulation/session/modules/planning.tips.test.ts.

rejected: Finding 2 (autopilot does not act on the planted problem or the checklist; scenarios.test.ts 'scored steps of a clean case' fails on seed led-1): I confirmed it still fails for this reason. The fix belongs in src/simulation/session/autopilot.ts and scenarios.test.ts, which this package does not own. Follow-up for the autopilot owner: in prepare(), read every item with planningOf(s)?.actions.readItem. Then act with the first PLANTED_PROBLEMS[planted].correct entry other than hold-and-delay, choosing 'proceed' where actionFits says so, and do nothing when planted is null (an acute case can now have no problem). Then flushLine, zero, and confirm each PRE_PUNCTURE_CHECKLIST item, calling giveOxygen first if spo2 is refused.

Finding 6 (the collagen plug shown on ultrasound): this needs src/simulation/access/site.ts (a SiteOverrides plug field) and src/ui/access/UltrasoundView.tsx, both outside this package. The browser acceptance item stays unmet until a follow-up package draws it from planningOf(s).state.record.facts.closureDevice.

Finding 10 (tips test run in pde5-24h, not doac-recent): the plan's literal wording cannot be met in a meaningful way. diag-planning-pde5-nitrate is a PDE-5 tip, and nothing in doac-recent raises hypotension through a nitrate. The plan entry in docs/curriculum/lab-build-plan.json needs amending to name pde5-24h; I cannot edit it from this package.

Finding 13 (docs/realism/facts entries for MP_PRE_PROCEDURE, MP_PLANNING, MP_PLANNING_TIME, MP_OXYGEN_LPM, and a premedication factor on the previous-reaction probability): both need files outside this package (docs/realism/facts and found-patient-formulary's engine or responses.ts). Reported as follow-ups.
